newsitem.title: DUBAI: BOXING-EUBANK MAY FIGHT IN DUBAI, NEWSPAPER SAYS.
newsitem.headline: BOXING-EUBANK MAY FIGHT IN DUBAI, NEWSPAPER SAYS.

text.p: Chris Eubank, Britain's former World Boxing Organisation (WBO) super-middleweight champion, plans to stage a world title fight in Dubai later this year, a local newspaper said on Friday.

"We are looking at a series of fights in Dubai," he was quoted by the United Arab Emirate's (UAE) English-language Gulf News daily as saying. "The first could be a championship fight...on February 27, followed by possible fights in April, July and November." He was attending a horse race in Dubai.
Eubank stopped Argentine Louis Barrera in an uninspiring return from retirement in Cairo last October.
